scenes.heading: Understanding leverage and margin risk before using them

sents.d: Understanding leverage and margin risk before using them
Leverage magnifies both gains and losses — and losses can exceed your original deposit.

Leverage lets you control a larger position than your account balance alone would allow, which means both gains and losses are magnified by the same ratio — a small adverse price move can wipe out a disproportionate share of your account.

Margin calls (being required to add funds or having a position automatically closed) happen faster than many new traders expect, especially at higher leverage ratios, and during volatile periods this can happen with little warning.

Most experienced traders treat high leverage as a tool for very specific, well-understood strategies — not a way to make a small account grow faster — precisely because the downside risk scales just as fast as the upside.

take: Understand how fast leverage can wipe out an account before using it.
